exposure: Breastfeeding the previous child or otherwise
cohort: 546 mothers who delivered babies in public healthcare facilities in the Al-Qassim Region, Saudi Arabia
finding: The prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding was low (23.1%) and was significantly associated with mode of delivery, antenatal education about breastfeeding, and postnatal care practices, particularly help with breastfeeding positioning, 24-hour rooming-in, and encouragement to breastfeed early.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant factor associated with early initiation of breastfeeding.
